thread:
Maria: Heads-up — a few new support tickets showing really vague errors during onboarding. Users on the JS SDK get `Error: internal server error` with no code or request_id, and the client is auto-retrying which causes duplicate create calls. :grimacing:

Olivia: Got one from a user — snippet below. They hit a 401, then JS client retried and the second attempt returned 500 with message 'Something went wrong'.
Olivia: ```json
{
  "status":500,
  "message":"internal server error"
}
```

Raj: Ugh. This rings a bell — JS SDK currently normalizes to Error with message only unless we throw our typed exceptions. Py has typed exceptions (`RedwoodAuthError`, `RedwoodServerError`) but JS landed a minimal change last quarter and we never shipped typed classes.

Raj: The retry behaviour is also different: JS auto-retries on 5xx by default (retry count 1) and doesn't surface the original 401; Py doesn't retry on auth. That's why they see a 401 then a 500.

Kevin: This is a pretty bad DX for new users — onboarding flow can fail silently. Can we scope a fix? Prioritize?

Raj: Proposal: 1) standardize HTTP status mapping across SDKs, 2) add a stable error JSON shape in the API responses, 3) add typed exception classes in JS and update docs + sample app to show correct auth flow.

Maria: What do you mean by "stable error JSON shape"? Example?

Raj: Something like:```json
{
  "error":{
    "code":"AUTH_EXPIRED",
    "message":"API key expired",
    "retryable":false,
    "request_id":"rwx-239fjwe"
  }
}
```
Raj: And map code -> HTTP status (AUTH_EXPIRED -> 401). Make sure SDKs convert that into typed exception with fields: .code, .message, .retryable, .requestId.

Olivia: If we put request_id in all errors it will make support debugging way easier. +1. Also, sample app should show how to handle retries when retryable=true.

Kevin: Can we do this incrementally? e.g.: API returns error shape (backwards compatible), then JS SDK adds typed exceptions and turns off auth-triggered retries, then update sample app.

Raj: Yep. Suggested rollout: API change behind feature flag for 2 weeks, SDKs read new shape when present, fall back to old behavior if missing. Then flip flag after we update SDKs and sample. I'll open INF-3456 to track.

Maria: Assign owners + rough ETA? We should aim for a patch in 2 weeks for SDK changes so onboarding isn't blocked for new customers this quarter.

Raj: I can do the JS SDK typed exceptions + test coverage (2w). Kevin — can you own coordinating API flag with backend?

Kevin: I will. I'll sync with infra and create a short spec. I'll also add a note to the onboarding checklist to disable client-side retry-by-default for auth failures.

Olivia: I'll update the sample app to include explicit auth error handling and a small note in the quickstart about token rotation.

deploy-bot: Deployed branch `feature/error-shape` to staging at https://staging.redwood.ai (build 2026-03-20_11:24) :rocket:

Maria: Thanks team. Can we also add 1-2 unit tests that assert we don't retry on 401? Those caught the original bug.

Raj: Yep adding tests now. I'll post the PR when ready: https://github.com/redwood-inference/js-sdk/pull/987

Kevin: Great. If anyone sees more onboarding noise, ping me and I'll escalate.

Olivia: +1 on request_id for all errors. Makes support life easier.

Maria: OK closing loop here — owners: Raj (JS SDK), Kevin (API rollout), Olivia (sample app/support docs). Timeline: feature flag + staging test this week, SDK PR and tests in 2 weeks. Thanks!
